title: Beans! 🌱
description: Straight from Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga, the iconic beans of the Beanbean Kingdom arrive in Minecraft!
body:
Straight from Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga, the iconic beans of the Beanbean Kingdom arrive in Minecraft!

This resource pack replaces the Turnips with three different types of beans from the kingdom:

🌿 Included beans:

🟢 Woo Beans – the most common green beans

🌸 Chuckle Beans – rarer pink beans

🌕 Hee Beans – the rarest and hardest to find yellow beans

Each one has been recreated with custom models and textures, staying faithful to their original appearance from the game. 🎨

⚙️ Requirements:
To use this pack properly, you will need:

The Minecraft Forge mod loader

The Mario Mania mod by YoshyMaker (required for the DLC to work)

GeckoLib

PlayerAnimator (1.19.4)

Bring a small but iconic part of the Beanbean Kingdom into your Minecraft world and start collecting them all! 🌱💛

#MarioAndLuigi #SuperstarSaga #Minecraft #ResourcePack #MarioMania #Modding
